Description.Content: Applies the Sigmoid Linear Unit (SiLU) function, element-wise. The SiLU function is also known as the swish function.
LLaMA RoPE Simple Only calculate: value1 = in_value * cos_value - in_value_2 * sin_value and value2 = in_value * sin_value + in_value_2 * cos_value.
Scaled dot-product attention via FlashAttention online softmax. Inputs Q, K, V are NHWC = [B, S, H, D]. Supports GQA when H_q is a multiple of H_kv. Output has the same shape as Q.

fp16 FlashAttention with rx32 dot + rx2 V mad + vectorised online softmax stats (M, S). Same op signature as FlashAttention so it slots into existing graphs by node type only. fp16 inputs/outputs only.

Scaled dot-product attention via FlashAttention online softmax. Q is fp16; K and V are u8 with per-tensor symmetric quant (zp=128, scale supplied as scalar params). Layout matches FlashAttention: NHWC = [B, S, H, D]. Supports GQA when H_q is a multiple of H_kv. Output has the same shape as Q.
K : [B, S_kv, H_kv, D] (u8 zp=128 sym)
V : [B, S_kv, H_kv, D] (u8 zp=128 sym)

Fused (scale + block-sparse causal mask + softmax) for the decomposed block-sparse attention graph. Replaces the Mul(QK, scale) + Add(QKs, mask) + Softmax sequence with one op. The mask is structurally implied by q_block_idx and bk (no mask tensor is materialised).
P : softmax over the last axis of in[0]

Big-batch variant of SoftmaxBlockSparseCausal for the big-batch rank-3 sparse pipeline. Inputs: QK and a slice_base uint32 scalar (set to 0 by the user; replaced per-slice by AUTOSPLIT with the slice's global row offset). Per-row qb index is computed as (slice_base + h_local) % num_qb.
slice_base : uint32 scalar (graph-time 0; replaced per-slice by AUTOSPLIT)
P : softmax over the last axis of in[0]
